brief: Re-run only. This package exists because round 1's check couldn't run, not because anything failed. In b5 round 1 every finding came back fixed. The H verifier (verify-b5-r1-H.md) ruled WEB-9 fixed from the code: 'Type instead' is `className="text-link voice-mode-link"` with no aria-pressed or role (`src/components/VoiceDemo.tsx:927-934`), and the render `voice-capture.en.mobile.light.panel.png` shows it as an underlined link. The tester then added `WEB-9: ‘Type instead’ is a text-link button, not a toggle, in each language` (`tests/ux-web-voice.spec.ts:2144`). Right after, WSL stopped starting (first `getpwuid(1000) failed 5 … I/O error`, then `Wsl/Service/CreateInstance/E_UNEXPECTED` after `wsl --shutdown`). So that test, and `npm run check` with it in the file, never ran. Everything else in the round's check had passed before the outage, including the Turnstile options test (:2112) and the word scan (:2157).

web-ux-implementer: change no file. Don't build. First confirm WSL starts with one harmless command, for example `wsl -e true`. If it doesn't, stop at once and return 'blocked' with the error: infrastructure, not the site. Don't run `wsl --shutdown` or `wsl --terminate`; in round 1 a second shutdown left WSL unable to start at all. If WSL starts, return 'done' with no files changed.

web-ux-tester: run, in WSL from the website root, `npx playwright test tests/ux-web-voice.spec.ts --grep "Type instead. is a text-link|no string the demo can show|Turnstile is rendered"` on both projects (desktop 1440 × 1000 and mobile 390 × 664), then `npm run check`, then the round's usual full check. If the 'Type instead' test fails because of the test itself (a wrong selector, or `VOICE.typeInstead` not matching the copy), fix the test, not the site, and say what you changed. If it fails because the button really is filled, pressed or a toggle, report it as the site's failure on WEB-9. If WSL is still down, class every check as infrastructure and say so; don't re-run the renders for nothing.
H verifier: WEB-9 needs no new code reading. Rule from the tester's result for :2144 and the round check. Keep round 1's verdict unless that test fails on the site.

Don't touch: any file under `src/`; `voice.privacy` (WP49); the attributes of `<section id="voice">` (WP48); `src/styles/voice.css`; the copy; `src/components/HomePage.tsx`; the legal files (WP47); every committed test file.
acceptance: WEB-9: on /, /es/ and /ca/ at 1440 × 1000 and 390 × 664, light theme, once the demo is open at the capture stage, exactly one button in `#voice` is named ‘Type instead’ / «Escribir» / «Escriu». It has the class `text-link`, no `aria-pressed` attribute and no fill, and `#voice` holds no role=switch and no role=checkbox (`tests/ux-web-voice.spec.ts:2144`, now run).
`npm run check` (next typegen && tsc --noEmit) passes with `tests/ux-web-voice.spec.ts` as it stands after round 1.
The Turnstile options test (:2112) and the word-scan test (:2157) still pass on both projects in the same run.
deviceChecks: Turnstile's real look on the deployed site, with Cloudflare's widget instead of the stand-in (carried from WEB-9).
The live demo with the real AI and a real microphone on a phone, in Spanish: two taps, «Toca para hablar» then «Listo» (carried from WEB-9).
